next.reason: 1985: 'If STOP literal-1 is specified, the execution of the run unit is suspended and literal-1 is communicated to the operator.'; 2023: 'Format is only STOP RUN [WITH ERROR/NORMAL STATUS literal-1]; "Execution of the run unit terminates"'. The 2023 STOP format offers only STOP RUN. The suspend-and-resume STOP literal-1 is gone. A literal in WITH STATUS is passed to the OS at termination, not shown to an operator awaiting resumption.
